item.text: The campaign is live with the product explanation and 60-day offer posts. Both ad groups target CI-related keywords in the UK and Ireland, with audience expansion disabled. Their lifetime caps total $500, and delivery ends at midnight after Sunday 29 November, UK time. I’ll check initial delivery today and review performance daily.

The first review shows $67.46 spent and 16 link clicks. The product post has a slightly lower cost per click, but there is too little data to call a winner. I’m keeping both running into Monday to see how the engineering audience responds during the working week.

Through Tuesday’s review, spend is $172.86 for 49 link clicks. The product explanation is delivering clicks at $3.29 versus $3.93 for the offer post. I’ve moved $50 of the remaining allocation toward the product post, keeping the combined lifetime cap at $500. This is a click-efficiency decision; sign-up performance remains unobservable in X.

Thursday’s review shows $277.72 spent and 74 link clicks, with the product post still ahead on cost per click. For the final three days, I’ll add your approved Sunday-deadline post to the offer ad group, using its existing budget.

item.text: Saturday’s review shows $369.06 spent and 94 link clicks. I’ve increased the daily allowances for the remaining weekend so the campaign can use more of its remaining budget before the offer closes. The lifetime caps remain $350 and $150.

Sunday’s midday review shows $458.44 spent and 119 link clicks. Both groups are still delivering, with $41.56 left under the shared cap. I’ll check again this evening and confirm shutdown at the offer deadline.
The campaign has ended at midnight UK time and is confirmed unable to serve. I’m allowing an hour for reporting to catch up before collecting the recap.

The campaign ran 21–29 November, UK time, with daily monitoring and is now stopped.
